simple.meaning: עִזְקָא (ʻizqâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a signet-ring (as engraved).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עִזְקָא (H5824) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 6:18, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עִזְקָא (H5824) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עִזְקָא (H5824) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עִזְקָא (ʻizqâʼ) / H5824 is traced through Daniel 6:18 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
